Subject: Hightide subscription renewal & QBR — kickoff and next steps

Hi Elena / Hightide procurement team,

Following up on our renewal cycle coming up in March — wanted to start the kickoff so we can lock timeline, headcount for staffing, and any term changes up front. Summary below and a suggested cadence.

Quick summary
- Current term ends: 2028-03-31
- Current committed capacity: 80k tokens/day average, 200k burst
- Hightide ask (prelim): +20% committed capacity, longer 18-month term considered

Proposed kickoff timeline
1) This week (Jan 10–13): confirm capacity uplift number and any compliance redlines
2) Jan 16–24: procurement intake, legal redlines + updated SOW draft
3) Jan 25: QBR + contract handshake (proposed slot below)
4) Early Feb: DocuSign and operational onboarding for uplift

Proposed QBR slots (pick one):
- Thu, Jan 25, 2028 — 10:00–11:00 PT (preferred)
- Tue, Jan 30, 2028 — 11:00–12:00 PT

Action items for Hightide
- Confirm desired committed token uplift (percent or target TPS)
- Share procurement form / PO contact (if different from this thread)
- Flag any compliance or SSO/KMS requirements now so legal can triage

I've attached a short renewal_summary_v1.pdf with capacity estimates and a rough pricing sketch for the 18-month vs 12-month path. Marissa and Ben will support on pricing and operational ramp. Connor will be our SRE lead for the onboarding plan.

If the proposed Jan 25 QBR works, I can send a calendar invite (Calendly link below) and we can attach a short one-pager for stakeholders.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Priyom Das

Also looping in procurement so they can advise on lead times for PO/contract.

PRIYOM / BEN — quick internal sync notes after Elena's reply.

Notes
- They confirmed ~+20% committed uplift pending pricing. That's the seat-of-ops ask; we should size the GPU footprint and staff ramp for that. Connor should estimate the ops headcount + runway.
- They prefer Jan 31 for the QBR (afternoon PT). We should hold Jan 25 tentative but shift primary invite to Jan 31 if procurement needs more time.
- Procurement form attached by Elena — legal will need to review typical SLA/term language (priority: data retention, ingress/egress controls, KMS).

Proposed Redwood asks (internal)
1) Offer a 12-month and 18-month pricing ladder with a blended effective rate for the uplift — show savings on 18-month vs 12-month.
2) Limited promotional credits for first 60 days of uplift to smooth migration risk.
3) Standard SLA language unless procurement raises specific exceptions — flag early if they do.

Action owners
- Ben: prepare pricing ladder + one-pager by EOD Jan 12
- Connor: ops ramp estimate + onboarding checklist by Jan 13
- Priyom: confirm QBR date preference with Elena and send calendar hold once confirmed

Also recommend we prep a short technical appendix for the QBR that shows latency and failover patterns for burst vs committed lanes — that usually helps procurement feel comfortable.

— Marissa
